groups.name: Group Name
groups.Global_desc: Grants full, unrestricted super-user control over all modules and configurations across the entire system.
groups.Admin_desc: Grants access to general administration settings and overall system configurations.
groups.CSV_desc: Allows bulk-uploading and importing of system data from CSV spreadsheet templates.
groups.Report_desc: Grants permission to view generated activity logs, inventory summaries, and historical reports.
groups.Assets_desc: Enables full lifecycle control of physical assets (view, check-in, check-out, audit, create, edit, delete).
groups.Accessories_desc: Allows managing accessory items (e.g., keyboards, mouse, chargers) including check-in, check-out, and stock counts.
groups.Consumables_desc: Allows managing consumable inventory (e.g., paper, ink cartridges) and tracking their distribution.
groups.License_desc: Enables tracking, checking out seats, and organizing software licenses and serial keys.
groups.Component_desc: Allows managing internal modular components (e.g., RAM, SSD, Graphic Cards) that can be installed inside assets.
groups.Users_desc: Allows creating and managing employee accounts, credentials, contact information, and system login access.
groups.Models_desc: Allows creating specifications and models for physical hardware assets.
groups.Categories_desc: Allows configuring inventory category definitions (e.g., Laptops, Software, Office Desks).
groups.Departments_desc: Allows setting up organizational departments (e.g., Engineering, HR, Sales) for assigning assets.
groups.Statuslabel_desc: Allows configuring asset lifecycle labels (e.g., Ready to Deploy, In Repair, Archived, Out for Service).
groups.Suppliers_desc: Allows managing external vendors and suppliers directory information.
groups.Manufacturers_desc: Allows managing hardware manufacturers and brand list.
groups.Location_desc: Allows setting up offices, warehouses, and branch locations.
groups.Companies_desc: Allows managing parent companies or branch legal entities.
groups.Depreciations_desc: Allows setting up asset value depreciation profiles over time for financial tracking.
groups.Self_desc: Allows users to view their own profile, self-checkout/request assets, and manage two-factor authentication.
groups.BranchesDropdown_desc: Enables or disables the branch-filtering selector in the header navigation bar.
groups.EditGroupPermissions_desc: Allows the creation, modification, and deletion of role-based user groups and permission profiles.
groups.group_global_control_desc: Administrative, data imports, and system-wide capability controls.
groups.group_assets_inventory_desc: Permissions controlling physical devices, licenses, components, accessories, and consumables.
groups.group_directory_setup_desc: Configuration directories for organizational metadata, models, status labels, branch locations, and companies.
